mapper.select: SELECT f.id AS farm_id, f.name AS name, c.name AS category_name, u.name AS owner_name, u.phone AS owner_phone, f.audit_status AS audit_status, f.disabled AS disabled, f.frozen AS frozen, CONCAT(f.province, ' · ', f.district) AS region_text, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_farm_member m WHERE m.farm_id = f.id AND m.active_flag = 1 AND m.status = 'ACTIVE') AS member_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.current_count), 0) FROM t_batch b WHERE b.farm_id = f.id AND b.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.deleted = 0) AS stock_count, CASE c.count_unit WHEN 'HEAD' THEN '头' WHEN 'BIRD' THEN '只' ELSE c.count_unit END AS stock_unit, f.approved_at AS approved_at, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(record_count), 0) FROM t_user_active_day uad WHERE uad.farm_id = f.id AND uad.stat_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}) AS records_7d, (SELECT fc.id FROM t_farm_change fc WHERE fc.farm_id = f.id AND fc.status = 'PENDING' LIMIT 1) AS pending_change_id, CASE WHEN f.audit_status = 'PENDING' THEN f.latest_audit_id END AS pending_audit_id, f.version AS version FROM t_farm f JOIN t_user u ON u.id = f.owner_user_id LEFT JOIN t_category c ON c.id = f.main_category_id WHERE ORDER BY f.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT * FROM t_farm WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(current_count), 0) FROM t_batch WHERE farm_id = #{farmId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_batch WHERE farm_id = #{farmId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(record_count), 0) FROM t_user_active_day WHERE farm_id = #{farmId} AND stat_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.user_id) FROM t_farm_member m JOIN t_user_active_day uad ON uad.user_id = m.user_id AND uad.farm_id = m.farm_id WHERE m.farm_id = #{farmId} AND m.active_flag = 1 AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND uad.stat_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND uad.op_count > 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_farm_member WHERE farm_id = #{farmId} AND active_flag = 1 AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT m.user_id AS user_id, u.name AS name, u.phone AS phone, m.role AS role, m.joined_at AS joined_at, u.last_login_at AS last_login_at, GROUP_CONCAT(p.pen_name ORDER BY p.id SEPARATOR '、') AS pen_text FROM t_farm_member m JOIN t_user u ON u.id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN t_member_pen mp ON mp.member_id = m.id AND mp.farm_id = m.farm_id LEFT JOIN t_pen p ON p.id = mp.pen_id AND p.farm_id = mp.farm_id WHERE m.farm_id = #{farmId} AND m.active_flag = 1 AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY m.user_id, u.name, u.phone, m.role, m.joined_at, u.last_login_at ORDER BY FIELD(m.role, 'OWNER', 'MANAGER', 'STAFF'), m.joined_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_farm_invite WHERE farm_id = #{farmId} AND status = #{status}

SELECT CONCAT('第 ', a.submit_no, ' 次提交') AS event, a.submitted_at AS time, u.name AS actor, a.status AS tag, COALESCE(a.change_summary, CONCAT('提交注册信息，资质图 ', COALESCE(JSON_LENGTH(a.snapshot_json, '$.qualificationFileIds'), 0), ' 张')) AS description FROM t_farm_audit a LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id = a.created_by WHERE a.farm_id = #{farmId} UNION ALL SELECT CASE a.status WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN '注册审核通过' ELSE '注册审核驳回' END, a.audited_at, ad.name, a.status, CASE a.status WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN a.audit_opinion ELSE a.reject_reason END FROM t_farm_audit a LEFT JOIN t_admin ad ON ad.id = a.audited_by WHERE a.farm_id = #{farmId} AND a.audited_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT '所有者提交资料变更', c.created_at, u.name, c.status, COALESCE(c.remark, '') FROM t_farm_change c LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id = c.created_by WHERE c.farm_id = #{farmId} UNION ALL SELECT CASE c.status WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN '资料变更审核通过' ELSE '资料变更审核驳回' END, c.audited_at, ad.name, c.status, CASE c.status WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN c.audit_opinion ELSE c.reject_reason END FROM t_farm_change c LEFT JOIN t_admin ad ON ad.id = c.audited_by WHERE c.farm_id = #{farmId} AND c.audited_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CASE o.op_action WHEN 'FREEZE' THEN '冻结养殖场' ELSE '解冻养殖场' END, o.created_at, o.operator_name, o.result, o.reason FROM t_operation_log o WHERE o.biz_type = 'FARM' AND o.biz_id = #{farmId} AND o.op_type = 'FARM' AND o.op_action IN ('FREEZE', 'UNFREEZE') ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT id FROM t_farm_change WHERE farm_id = #{farmId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT name FROM t_admin WHERE id = #{adminId} LIMIT 1
